prompt: Spec this requirement as acceptance criteria: Only admins can delete a project. Members see the Delete button disabled with the tooltip "Only admins can delete projects." A deleted project stays in Trash for 30 days. After a page reload the project list still does not show the deleted project.
output:
## Acceptance criteria: delete a project

Requirement: Only admins can delete a project; Members see a disabled Delete button with a tooltip; a deleted project stays in Trash for 30 days; and after a page reload, the project list still does not show the deleted project.

### Permissions and roles
AC-1. Given a user who is an admin, when the admin deletes a project, then the project is deleted. _Only admins can delete a project._
AC-2. Given a user who is a member, when the member views the Delete button, then the Delete button is disabled. _Members see the Delete button disabled_
AC-3. Given a user who is a member, when the member views the disabled Delete button, then the tooltip "Only admins can delete projects." is shown. _with the tooltip "Only admins can delete projects."_

### Persistence after reload
AC-4. Given a project that has been deleted, when the page is reloaded, then the project list does not show the deleted project. _After a page reload the project list still does not show the deleted project._

### Limits
AC-5. Given a project that was deleted less than 30 days ago, when Trash is opened, then the deleted project is shown in Trash. _A deleted project stays in Trash for 30 days._

### Open questions
- [minor] Limits: What happens to a deleted project when its 30 days in Trash end? Limits: From what moment are the 30 days counted?
- [minor] Permissions and roles: Which roles can open Trash? Main path: What can a user do with a project while it is in Trash?

### Out of scope
None stated.
